title: Cycle length is not part of the rule: a six-ply chase cycle is a violation
rationale: The cannon flees across three files (a5, b5, c5) and the rook follows on rank 3, renewing the attack from a3, b3 and c3 in turn, so the repeating cycle is six plies rather than four. The rule counts occurrences of a position and the renewal of the attack on one and the same piece; the length of the cycle plays no part, and the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence exactly as in mx-chs-001.
